tools_resignCardDescription: Pick one level for each aspect such as income, benefits, commuting, overtime, growth and health, and get an overall score for your current job in 1 minute.
tools_resignSubtitle: Each item is worth up to 10 points; choose the level that best matches your current situation. After all ten items are completed, the total score and the corresponding result are calculated automatically.
tools_resignReadyAll: All ten items are scored. You can view the assessment result.
tools_resignFooterNote: This score is calculated from ten aspects of your current situation, including income, benefits, commuting, work boundaries, development and physical and mental health.
tools_offerCardDescription: Compare the income, benefits, time cost, stability and growth prospects of multiple jobs to see each one's overall strengths and weaknesses.
tools_offerSubtitle: Fill in the income, benefits, time cost, stability and growth prospects of multiple offers item by item, then view the overall ranking and item-by-item pros and cons.
tools_offerReadyAll: All comparison items are completed. You can view the result.
tools_offerResultInsufficientInfo: Not enough comparable information to make a judgment for now
tools_offerResultSingleCompany: Only one company has comparable information
tools_offerResultTopClose: The top-ranked offers perform similarly overall
tools_offerScoreNote: Overall score prorated from known items
tools_offerFooterNote: Unclear dimensions are excluded from that company's score, and results are prorated separately based on the information actually known for each company. Please make your final decision based on your personal priorities, risk tolerance and long-term goals.
tools_wageCardDescription: Factor in alternating six-day schedules, single rest days, overtime and commuting to find the real hourly return of this job.
tools_wageSubtitle: Include alternating schedules, single rest days, daily working hours and commuting to see the real hourly return of this job.
tools_wagePackageHint: Unit: CNY; includes fixed monthly salary, fixed bonuses and stated fixed allowances.
tools_wageExtraHint: Unit: CNY; only fill in overtime pay or fixed cash allowances not yet included in the package, or zero if none.
tools_wageMonthlyRestHint: Excludes the paid annual leave and statutory holidays filled in separately below.
tools_wageCommuteHint: Unit: minutes; enter zero if working from home.
tools_wageLeaveHint: Unit: days; enter the days you can actually use.
tools_wageErrorDays: Annual rest days must be fewer than 365.
tools_wagePrivacyNote: All inputs are kept on this page only for instant estimation and are never uploaded.
tools_wageResultSubtitle: Both working time and round-trip commuting are included
tools_wageEquivalentBefore: For a job with the same daily working hours, commuting, annual leave and statutory holidays, a standard two-day-weekend annual salary of
tools_wageEquivalentAfter: would match the real hourly wage of your current job.
tools_wageHoursDiff: Each year your current schedule takes {hours} hours {mode} a standard two-day weekend.
tools_wageFooterNote: Results are estimated on the basis of 365 days and 52 weeks a year, excluding after-hours standby time, emotional strain, benefit value and income taxes. Please judge based on your actual situation.
